home.titlePre: Practice from real experience. The next question
home.lead: This preview is being built for that: follow-ups stay on the last answer, sessions stay resumable, and the review is for your own recap — not a calibrated capability assessment.
home.cardQ: How would you design a high-concurrency rate limiter?
home.cardA: Use a Redis counter, +1 per request, reject above the threshold…
home.cardNote: You mentioned a counter, but talk through sliding vs. fixed window trade-offs and atomicity in a distributed setting — covering those makes it solid.
home.stat1l: the AI follows up on your answers, not a fixed list
home.stat2l: leave midway and pick up where you stopped
home.stat3l: every note traces back to your answer — no made-up scores
home.stat4l: per-question notes, only for you, showing where you stalled
home.pathH2: Real experience → adaptive interview → reviewable growth
home.path1Desc: The resume and projects are practice material. Wording can change; the career cannot be invented.
home.path2Desc: Text practice follows your answer. It is not a list you finish.
home.path3Desc: Per-question notes are for you. You can see where you stalled.
home.arch1Desc: The system asks the next question from your last answer. It is not a recruiter using the product.
home.arch2Desc: Progress is stored in the database, not the browser.
home.arch3Desc: Every conclusion passes local checks before it reaches you — opening a page is not acceptance.
home.arch4Desc: Notes are for review. They are not a capability certification.
home.arch5Desc: Each practice step is written twice on purpose — progress and records always agree.
home.featH2: Sort the story, practice, read the notes, then look again.
home.cap1Desc: Make the story clear and mark weak spots.
home.cap2Desc: Asked from your experience and the role you want, not a dump.
home.cap3Desc: Text practice. The next question follows what you just said. The GitHub Pages / Web showcase does not accept answers. A public-preview API may allow one controlled ledger POST; that is not a production answer route.
home.cap4Desc: What to fill in. For personal review, not a capability certification.
home.cap5Desc: A few sessions stay together so you can reread them.
home.cap6Desc: Progress is stored so you can pick the session back up.
home.stmtTitle: The next question follows you. Notes are for review.
home.stmtP: Notes are for your own review. It is not a calibrated capability assessment and must not be used for hiring, eligibility, or offer decisions.
home.footDesc: Preview. Practice from real experience. Hiring features are available to enterprise accounts.
home.footNote: Preview · voice and resume image reading are opening in stages. Notes are not a capability certification.

interview.concludeEarlyWeak: Practice ended early after sustained weakness or repeated unresolved turns (adaptive control flow, not a capability grade or hiring verdict)
interview.concludeSpin: Practice ended early after repeated question churn (adaptive control flow, not a capability grade or hiring verdict)
interview.rlMessage: Too many concurrent connections (possibly multiple tabs). Auto-reconnect has slowed down; answered content is not lost. Close other tabs or retry manually.
interview.svMessage: The service is temporarily unavailable and auto-reconnecting. Answered content is not lost; unsaved drafts are kept on this page.
interview.ceMessage: The server is rotating connections and seamlessly resuming. Answered content is not lost…
interview.dfMessage: Reconnecting to the same interview; answered content is not lost…
interview.fencedMessage: This interview has entered the data-deletion flow. Please start a new interview.
interview.authMessage: Your session has expired and the practice connection stopped. Please sign in again to continue; answered content is saved on the server.
interview.nfMessage: This practice was not found, or this account cannot access it. Auto-reconnect has stopped; you can go back to the list.
interview.stopMessage: The practice service stays unavailable; auto-reconnect is paused. You can retry later or go back to the list.
interview.closedMessage: The practice connection has stopped and will not auto-reconnect with the same resume token. You can retry this practice or go back to the list.
interview.concludingMessage: Practice control flow has ended; generating practice feedback…
interview.reportUnavailableMessage: The interview is complete, but the report could not be generated. You can retry later or contact support.
interview.assessSettledMessage: The interview completed and the fee was settled, but no trustworthy score was obtained, so no report is generated this time. You can restart the job interview from “My applications”; other interviews can be started anew.
interview.assessReleasedMessage: Not enough trustworthy scoring evidence was obtained; the reserved credit has been released. You can restart the job interview from “My applications”; other interviews can be started anew.
interview.assessUnknownMessage: No trustworthy score was obtained this time and the interview has ended. You can restart the job interview from “My applications”; other interviews can be started anew.
interview.unavailableMessage: The interview failed to start or process and has stopped. You can retry or contact support — you will not be left waiting.
interview.errorMessage: The interview hit a problem. Your progress is saved; you can retry.

resumeUpload.helpPreview: Preview can recognize image resumes. Failures never invent text; upload a clearer image, PDF/Word, or paste text. Not a production visual-quality promise. ≤ 8MB
resumeUpload.helpStandard: Supports PDF / Word (.docx) · ≤ 8MB. Image recognition is not available here; paste text or upload a PDF with a text layer.
resumeUpload.cardPreview: Upload a PDF / Word file, or an image in preview environments. Image recognition failures never invent content.
resumeUpload.cardStandard: Upload a PDF / Word file, or paste text directly. Image recognition is not enabled in this environment.
resumeUpload.banner: Preview image recognition, not a production visual-quality promise. Failures are reported as-is; resume text is never invented.
